term: mathematical infinite greatest region and its coordinate extent
definition: Point is Fin 3 → ℝ and Region is Set Point under inclusion. whole is Set.univ. Both whole and the family of all regions are infinite; the family is order-bounded above by whole. coordinates s is the first-coordinate image of s in ℝ. Unboundedness of coordinates whole concerns the real order, not the region inclusion order, metric norm or intensive perfection. The explicit two-singleton subfamily has incomparable maximal elements and no greatest member.
